title: ADR-056: Document Lifecycle Graph Control Plane
summary: Accepted decision establishing the Git-backed DLG control-plane architecture, stable document identity, orthogonal metadata, and phased migration boundaries.
authority_scopes: Document Lifecycle Graph architecture and governance
Git-canonical document identity and metadata persistence

triggers: the decision is superseded or contradicted
the accepted DLG scope or canonical persistence doctrine materially changes
the normative DLG contract materially diverges from the decision
freshness.reason: The accepted decision and its normative contract were reviewed at the Phase 1 base.

read_when: making or reviewing a DLG architecture decision
interpreting DLG authority, persistence, or human-review boundaries
planning a separately approved DLG rollout phase
must_not_prove: DLG corpus migration or automatic document classification
resolver, retrieval, graph projection, or database implementation
